reviewedMappings.2024-3-12:0: Gas reaction quotient uses stoichiometric powers of partial pressures and equals K at equilibrium. Original mass balance and common pressure give initial 3n moles in 3 L; density gives V1=10/3 L and V2=9/2 L; equilibrium composition yields concentration ratio 4/3.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-12:1: Gas reaction quotient uses stoichiometric powers of partial pressures and equals K at equilibrium. Computed concentration ratio 4/3 excludes 5/4.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-12:2: Gas reaction quotient uses stoichiometric powers of partial pressures and equals K at equilibrium. Kp/P=yB²/(1−yB); y1=1/2 gives K1/P=1/2; K2/P=9/4 yields y2=3/4, yielding concentration ratio 4/3.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-12:3: Gas reaction quotient uses stoichiometric powers of partial pressures and equals K at equilibrium. Mole fraction ratio alone omits total molar concentration change.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-12:4: Gas reaction quotient uses stoichiometric powers of partial pressures and equals K at equilibrium. B amount in equilibrium I is not the requested concentration ratio.
reviewedMappings.2024-3-12:5: Gas reaction quotient uses stoichiometric powers of partial pressures and equals K at equilibrium. Kp ratio involves both species and is not directly the B concentration ratio.
